mapper.select: select t.FINPROD_ID as finprodId, t.FINPROD_MARKET_ID as finprodMarketId, t.FINPROD_ABBR as finprodAbbr, t.TRADE_MARKET as tradeMarket, t.REGIST_ORG as registOrg, a.APPEAR_MARKET_ID as appearMarketId, a.LISTING_DATE as listingDate, t.VDATE as vdate, t.MDATE as mdate, i.ISSUE_DATE as issueDate, t2.FINPROD_ABBR as appearMarketAbbr from fin_product t inner join fin_product_add a on t.FINPROD_ID = a.FINPROD_ID left join fin_product t2 on t2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID=a.APPEAR_MARKET_ID left join fin_product_issue i on t.FINPROD_ID=i.FINPROD_ID where t.FINPROD_ID=#{finprodId}

SELECT sec.SEC_ID as finprodMarketId, sec.BOND_NAME as finprodName, sec.BOND_ABBREVIATION as finprodAbbr, sec.TRADING_PLACES as tradeMarket, sec.REGISTERED_CUSTODIAN as registOrg, sec.ISSUER as issuer, sec.RAISE_MODE as issueType, sec.VALUE_DATE as vdate, sec.EXPIRY_DATE as mdate, sec.PRIMARY_CLASSIFICATION as type9, sec.SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION as type10, sec.VARIETY_OF_COUPONS as couponSpecies, sec.CURRENCY as ccy , sec.IS_BONDS_WITH_RIGHTS as isRight, sec.TRADING_CALENDAR as calendarId FROM INTERF_WIND_UNRELEASE_SEC_INFO sec where sec.SEC_ID=#{finprodMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and TRADING_PLACES in (#{TRADE_PLACE_01},#{TRADE_PLACE_02},#{TRADE_PLACE_03},#{TRADE_PLACE_04}) AND ROWNUM=1

SELECT sec.CROSS_MARKET_CODE as crossMarketCode, ri.LISTING_DATE as listingDate, ri.LISTING_CODE as appearMarketId FROM INTERF_WIND_UNRELEASE_SEC_INFO sec LEFT JOIN INTERF_WIND_RELEASE_INFO ri ON sec.SEC_ID = ri.SEC_ID LEFT JOIN (select * from INTERF_RDI_RELEASE_INFO where SECURITY_TYPE in ('CD','14')) pri ON pri.SECURITY_ID = sec.SEC_ID where sec.SEC_ID=#{finprodMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and sec.TRADING_PLACES in (#{TRADE_PLACE_01},#{TRADE_PLACE_02},#{TRADE_PLACE_03},#{TRADE_PLACE_04}) AND ROWNUM=1

SELECT nvl(pri.ISSUE_METHOD,ri.ISSUING_METHOD) as issueClass, nvl(pri.BIDDING_METHOD,ri.BIDDING_METHOD) as tenderType, ri.TENDER_TARGET as tenderTarget, nvl(pri.ISSUE_SIZE * 100000000,ri.ISSUE_SIZE) as planIssueAmt, ri.RELEASE_TYPE as issueStyle, ri.ADDITIONAL_BATCHES as addBatch, nvl(pri.ISSUE_PX,ri.ISSUE_PX) as issuePrice, nvl(pri.COUPON_RATE,nvl(ri.STIPULATION_VALUE,ri.COUPON_RATE)) as referYield, nvl(pri.BENCHMARK_CURVE_NAME,ri.BENCHMARK_CURVE_NAME) as intRateId, nvl(pri.DECIMAL_PLACES,ri.DECIMAL_PLACES) as rateGrade, nvl(pri.SPREAD,ri.SPREAD) as bp, nvl(to_date(pri.ISSUE_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd'),ri.ISSUE_DATE) as issueDate, nvl(to_date(pri.EVENT_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd'),ri.EVENT_DATE) as payDate, nvl(to_date(pri.INTEREST_ACCRUAL_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd'),ri.INTEREST_ACCRUAL_DATE) as firstConfirmDate, ri.ISSUE_START_TIME as issueSdate, ri.ISSUE_END_TIME as issueEdate, nvl(to_date(pri.EVENT_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd'),ri.PAYMENT_DEADLINE) as payEdate, ri.DEBT_REGISTRATION_DATE as assignRegdate, nvl(pri.SINGLE_MIN_SUB_AMT * 100000000,ri.SINGLE_MIN_SUB_AMT) as minPamt, nvl(pri.SINGLE_MAX_SUB_AMT * 100000000,ri.SINGLE_MAX_SUB_AMT) as maxPamt, nvl(pri.MAX_SUB_AMT * 100000000,ri.MAX_SUB_AMT) as maxTotalamt, nvl(pri.MAX_SUB_AMT * 100000000,ri.MIN_PER_TENDER_AMT) as minPerTamt, nvl(pri.MAX_PER_TENDER_AMT * 100000000,ri.MAX_PER_TENDER_AMT) as maxPerUtamt, nvl(pri.MIN_TENDER_PX_FOR_PLAN,ri.MIN_TENDER_PX_FOR_PLAN) as minTamt, nvl(pri.MAX_TENDER_PX_FOR_PLAN,ri.MAX_TENDER_PX_FOR_PLAN) as maxTamt, nvl(pri.TENDER_STEP,ri.TENDER_STEP) as tenderUnit, nvl(pri.MEDIAN_MAX_BID_MARKED,ri.MEDIAN_MAX_BID_MARKED) as maxTenderUnit, nvl(pri.MAX_TENDER_PX_DIFFER,ri.MAX_TENDER_PX_DIFFER) as maxTenderPlus, nvl(pri.CONTINUOUS_TENDER_LIMIT,ri.CONTINUOUS_TENDER_LIMIT) as seriYN, nvl(pri.MAX_TOTAL_TENDER_AMT * 100000000,ri.MAX_TOTAL_TENDER_AMT) as maxTotalTender, sec.RATE_TYPE as intType, pri.COUPON_PAYMENT_FREQUENCY as payCycle, ri.BID_DATE as tenderSdate, ri.BID_DATE as tenderEdate FROM INTERF_WIND_RELEASE_INFO ri LEFT JOIN INTERF_WIND_UNRELEASE_SEC_INFO sec on ri.SEC_ID = sec.SEC_ID LEFT JOIN (select * from INTERF_RDI_RELEASE_INFO where SECURITY_TYPE in ('CD','14')) pri ON pri.SECURITY_ID = ri.SEC_ID where ri.SEC_ID=#{finprodMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and sec.TRADING_PLACES in (#{TRADE_PLACE_01},#{TRADE_PLACE_02},#{TRADE_PLACE_03},#{TRADE_PLACE_04}) AND ROWNUM=1

select T1.FINPROD_ID from FIN_PRODUCT T1 where 1=1
AND T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2}
AND T1.TRADE_MARKET in(#{TRADE_PLACE_01},#{TRADE_PLACE_02},#{TRADE_PLACE_03},#{TRADE_PLACE_04})
AND T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID=#{finprodMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ROWNUM=1

select t.O_TYPE as oType, t.SHORT_LONG_TERM as shortLongTerm, t.GRADE_DATE as gradeDate, t.RATING as gradeResult, MCI.CUSTOMER_NAME as gradeOrg from ( SELECT ASSET_CODE,RATING,GRADE_ORG_ID,SHORT_LONG_TERM,O_TYPE,GRADE_DATE FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY BRATING.O_CODE ORDER BY BRATING.O_CODE,BRATING.GRADE_DATE DESC ,BRATING.GRADE_RESULT DESC) RANK,BRATING.O_CODE AS ASSET_CODE,BRATING.GRADE_RESULT AS RATING, BRATING.GRADE_ORG_ID as GRADE_ORG_ID,BRATING.SHORT_LONG_TERM as SHORT_LONG_TERM, BRATING.O_TYPE as O_TYPE,BRATING.GRADE_DATE as GRADE_DATE FROM MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING BRATING WHERE BRATING.O_TYPE = '01' AND BRATING.GRADE_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{platformDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') ) WHERE RANK=1 union all SELECT ASSET_CODE,RATING,GRADE_ORG_ID,SHORT_LONG_TERM,O_TYPE,GRADE_DATE FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY BRATING.O_CODE ORDER BY BRATING.O_CODE,BRATING.GRADE_DATE DESC ,BRATING.GRADE_RESULT DESC ) RANK ,BRATING.O_CODE AS ASSET_CODE ,BRATING.GRADE_RESULT AS RATING, BRATING.GRADE_ORG_ID as GRADE_ORG_ID,BRATING.SHORT_LONG_TERM as SHORT_LONG_TERM, BRATING.O_TYPE as O_TYPE,BRATING.GRADE_DATE as GRADE_DATE FROM MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING BRATING WHERE BRATING.O_TYPE = '02' AND BRATING.GRADE_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{platformDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') ) WHERE RANK=1 ) t LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO MCI ON MCI.CUSTOMER_ID=t.GRADE_ORG_ID where t.ASSET_CODE=#{finprodMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select count(1) as qty from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL where FINPROD_ID=#{finprodId} and IS_CANCEL ='N'

SELECT T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID id, T1.FINPROD_ABBR text, T1.FINPROD_NAME, T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.CALENDAR_ID, T1.TRADE_MARKET, T1.IS_RIGHT, T2.TYPE_9, T2.TYPE_10, T2.TYPE_11, to_char(T1.VDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') VDATE, to_char(T1.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') MDATE, T1.CCY FROM FIN_PRODUCT T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID
AND T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} AND T1.TRADE_MARKET in(#{TRADE_PLACE_01},#{TRADE_PLACE_02},#{TRADE_PLACE_03},#{TRADE_PLACE_04})
and T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{initValue}
and (T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) or T1.FINPROD_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) or T1.FINPROD_ABBR like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) or T1.FINPROD_ID like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) )

select t.secid as id, t.SECNAME as text, t.MARKET2 as TRADE_MARKET, t.VDATE, t.MDATE, null as FINPROD_TYPE2 from INTERF_PAYHSRCSECINFO t
AND t.MARKET2 not in(#{tradeMarket})
and t.secid = #{initValue}
and (t.secid like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) or t.SECNAME like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) )
union select t.FINPROD_MARKET_ID as id, t.FINPROD_ABBR as text, t.TRADE_MARKET, t.VDATE, t.MDATE, t.FINPROD_TYPE2 from FIN_PRODUCT t
AND t.TRADE_MARKET not in(#{tradeMarket})
and t.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{initValue}
and (t.FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) or t.FINPROD_ABBR like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) )
select T.TOTLE_TRADE_ID from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T where T.FINPROD_ID=#{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and T.IS_CANCEL='N' and rownum=1
